tagData.title: call-to-actions
tagData.name: Call to Actions
tagData.description: A call to action (CTA) is an instruction to the user, asking them to take a concrete action. Call-to-action buttons are an easy way to encourage visitors to take a specific action, such as buying a product, signing up for a newsletter, or reading an article.
